sources: President Zelensky (X + public address); FM Andrii Sybiha (X); Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov via Tass; Russian MOD drone tally via AA/anews
fault_line: Trump's sanctions waiver is funding Russia's winter blackout campaign — or the 'ceasefire' was never real and Zelensky is manufacturing leverage?

sections.what_happened: Zelensky: Russia deliberately attacked Ukrainian energy/oil/gas 76 times since Trump announced the Oct 11 energy ceasefire; overnight into Sunday, substations in Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Khmelnytskyi, Odesa hit, 'tens of thousands' without power; residential strikes killed 2, injured 12 (incl. 2 children); past week: ~2,700 drones, 1,700 aerial bombs, 66 missiles. Peskov Sunday: Russia's 'systematic and massive' retaliatory strikes continue to diminish Ukraine's 'offensive potential'. Russian MOD claimed 1,015 Ukrainian drones neutralized overnight (un-auditable).
sections.what_verified: Reuters, CNN, Ukrinform, Kyiv Independent, Kyiv Post, WION, Al Jazeera all relay Zelensky's X statement verbatim; AA/anews carry Peskov via Tass (crawled <1h). CNN notes neither Kyiv nor Moscow confirmed Trump's ceasefire announcement.
sections.what_disputed: Russian side: Peskov frames strikes as retaliation; MOD tallies (1,015 drones) un-auditable; Zelensky's '76 times' count is Ukrainian-side accounting, not independently audited.
sections.why_matters: Map-first: 76 strikes vs the waived sanctions — Zelensky's direct causal line ('they take every signal of an opportunity to make money as proof their bet on war is paying off') against the $10B diesel-deal figure from 1400-05. Pocketbook frame: Europe's €2.24/litre diesel and Ukraine's winter blackout in one beat. Label Zelensky's counts as Ukrainian claims; label the sanctions waiver as verified US action.
sections.context: Background: Russia/Ukraine — NEW in-window: Zelensky Sunday address — 76 energy strikes since Trump's Oct 11 'ceasefire'; Peskov says 'systematic and massive' retaliatory strikes continue

totw_analysis: Our read: Map-first: 76 strikes vs the waived sanctions — Zelensky's direct causal line ('they take every signal of an opportunity to make money as proof their bet on war is paying off') against the $10B diesel-deal figure from 1400-05. Pocketbook frame: Europe's €2.24/litre diesel and Ukraine's winter blackout in one beat. Label Zelensky's counts as Ukrainian claims; label the sanctions waiver as verified US action. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Trump's sanctions waiver is funding Russia's winter blackout campaign — or the 'ceasefire' was never real and Zelensky is manufacturing leverage?
